//: Copy to settings.local.json and edit. That file is gitignored, so your host, port, keys-adjacent config and feature flags never reach the repo. Anything here overrides settings.js. Comment keys starting with // are ignored.
//host: The Minecraft server, relative to whatever runs the bots.
//world: Optional label; groups agents in the dashboard and reports. Defaults to host:port.
//headless: No browser to open on a server.
//ollama_url: Where Ollama runs. Another box on your LAN is fine — point this at its GPU. One value moves every ollama/... model and embeddings at once. This file is gitignored, which is why your LAN address belongs here.
//flags: Turn these on one at a time so a failure has one obvious cause.
